works.work: Haklay, Orgad, Bau, Mueller, Belinkov. Position-aware Automatic Circuit Discovery. ACL 2025 (arXiv 2502.04577)
works.quote: we extend edge attribution patching, a gradient-based method for circuit discovery, to differentiate between token positions
works.relation: Method we follow in spirit: our four hand-written position classes (COND/SPEC/OPEN/DEC) are a dataset schema; the paper studies standard circuit tasks, not which algorithm a code model writes.
